[[File:Drassk_clan.png|thumb|right|200px|Drassk and his clan on Taris]]
Around [[3641 BBY]], the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Qyzen Fess]] issued a [[ghrajath]] to the traitorous Trandoshan [[Veneb Drassk]]. Accompanied by the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]], Fess '''confronted''' Drassk and his [[Veneb Drassk's clan|clanmates]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and killed the traitor. After Drassk's death, the rest of his clan chose to follow Fess, resulting in Fess becoming the new leader of Drassk's clan.
